players.product: Automated test equipment (UltraFLEXplus, Photon 100 SiPho/CPO test, Omnyx board test) for AI compute

quarterly_data.signal: Teradyne's test businesses manufacture primarily through subcontractors and outsourced contract manufacturers with significant operations in Malaysia. It depends on Flex Ltd. to manufacture and test its FLEX and J750 products in Malaysia, on Plexus Corp. to manufacture and test its FLEX and Magnum products in Malaysia and Thailand and its ETS products in Malaysia, and on SAM Meerkat to manufacture and test its storage test products in Malaysia and Thailand; it has also significantly invested in internal manufacturing for FLEX products at its Cebu site. As of December 31, 2025 Teradyne had non-cancelable purchase commitments for certain components and materials of approximately $1,473.0 million, of which $1,415.1 million is for less than one year.
quarterly_data.figure: contract manufacturers Flex (FLEX, J750), Plexus (FLEX, Magnum, ETS), SAM Meerkat (storage test); non-cancelable purchase commitments approximately $1,473.0 million, $1,415.1 million less than one year (December 31, 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Teradyne's 10-K refers to Infineon Technologies AG as a key customer, stating that the automated test equipment technology and development team (AET) Teradyne took over from Infineon strengthens the relationship between Teradyne and Infineon.
